[Selective Kernel Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.06586) demonstrate input-conditioned weighting of convolution branches at different scales, providing architectural motivation rather than evidence for recommendation gains. Recommended NextItNet controls: original backbone; parameter-matched backbone with useful additional channels; identical multiscale branches with fixed uniform gates; learned history-independent gates; history-conditioned gates. Match training, sampling, checkpoint selection and tuning budgets; report parameters and compute. Adaptive versus static gates isolates the contribution of conditioning more closely than adaptive versus baseline alone. Shuffling gate assignments across histories at inference provides a supplementary dependence diagnostic, though distribution shift limits causal interpretation. Each variant remains one jointly trained network per category.

For uncertainty, retain paired per-user hit indicators on exactly the same pinned candidates. Compute Δ = mean across four categories of their mean paired hit differences. Bootstrap users within each category, preserving model pairing, then recompute macro Δ for a 95% interval; report category deltas and discordant wins/losses. These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on trained checkpoints and fixed candidate sets; they exclude training randomness and negative-sampling variability. Sampled ranking metrics can reverse full-catalog comparisons, so interpret results strictly as pinned sampled HR@10 ([Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Repeated adaptive validation reuse can overfit the holdout ([Dwork et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629)). Prespecify contrasts, trial limits, stopping and checkpoint rules; disclose every attempted configuration and equalize search budgets. Ordinary bootstrap intervals around the selected winner do not correct selection bias. Keep validation findings exploratory and reserve confirmation for the host’s untouched final evaluation; do not modify the evaluator, splits or fixed seeds.
